title: Shiori Fujisaki in the Record Shop
teaser: On a weekday afternoon in the third-floor internal medicine observation ward, Shiori Fujisaki welcomes an unexpected patient—an old classmate from high school; once the joint consult and evening handoff wrap up, warm amber light awaits inside a classical record shop down an elm-lined side street.
gallery_caption: An afternoon joint consultation on the ward, followed by unhurried evening hours inside a classical record shop off an elm-lined side street.

choices.choice_slv2_100_a: “She is definitely thorough on the job—though seeing Dr. Fujisaki stumped by a patient like this is a rare sight.”
choices.choice_slv2_100_b: “Everyone at the hospital relies on her—she already had your whole diagnostic workup mapped out before calling me up.”
choices.choice_slv2_173_a: “Not trivial at all. I don't know music theory, yet hearing you describe ‘that extra half-second of held breath’ makes even me curious how it actually sounds.”
choices.choice_slv2_173_b: “Much more interesting than going over lab panels at the hospital—it's nice seeing Dr. Fujisaki so absorbed in something she loves.”
choices.choice_slv2_218_a: “Of course. Just pick something approachable first—if the version comparisons get too intricate, I might not catch the difference right away.”
choices.choice_slv2_218_b: “Sure—I'd actually love to hear what a recording that kept you waiting two whole months feels like.”

nodes.slv2_001: At 2:25 in the afternoon, sunlight filtering through the venetian blinds fell across the neat, pale flooring of the third-floor internal medicine observation ward.
nodes.slv2_002: By the window bed, Yuko Asahina—freshly admitted for short-term observation and changed into a loose hospital gown—was propped halfway up against her pillows. A canvas tote bag covered in trendy pins sat on her bedside cabinet, the latest street-snap fashion magazine peeking out of its zipper; one hand rested over her still-queasy stomach while the other held up her smartphone's front camera as she sighed repeatedly at her pale reflection.
nodes.slv2_003: “Ugh... If I'd known an ER visit would get me kept here overnight, I'd have put on some brightening lipstick before leaving the apartment—even if my stomach hurt enough to make me roll around...”
nodes.slv2_005: A gentle tap sounded against the half-shut ward door before it swung smoothly open.
nodes.slv2_006: Shiori Fujisaki stepped into the room holding a freshly printed admission assessment sheet, her gaze checking the bedside name card first before her warm, poised voice rang out.
nodes.slv2_008: The last syllable caught lightly on her lips the instant she got a clear look at the face on the bed.
nodes.slv2_009: Yuko Asahina's hand froze midair with her phone; she blinked twice, and then her eyes flew wide open.
nodes.slv2_011: Shiori's fingertips paused faintly against her chart clipboard, her standard clinical smile giving way to genuine surprise.
nodes.slv2_013: Silence hung over the ward for two full seconds.
nodes.slv2_014: The very next instant, Yuko tossed her phone onto the duvet and nearly bounced straight off the mattress in excitement—only to tug at the right side of her abdomen the moment she tensed up, sucking in a sharp hiss as she clutched her lower belly, caught somewhere between wincing and laughing.
nodes.slv2_015: “It really IS Shiori Fujisaki in the flesh!! When I was filling out the admission papers downstairs this morning, I was so busy groaning over the counter that I never even looked at the attending doctor's name—oh my gosh, you actually became a doctor?!”
nodes.slv2_016: Shiori stepped briskly to the bedside, instinctively steadying Yuko's shoulders to ease her back against the pillow while glancing at the back of her hand to make sure the IV line hadn't kinked; the composed reserve of an attending physician melted from her brow at once into fond exasperation toward an old friend.
nodes.slv2_017: “Easy now—you still have a cannula in the back of your hand. The bed transferred up from emergency this morning happened to be assigned to me; when I opened the chart at the nurses' station and saw ‘Yuko Asahina,’ I assumed it was just someone with the same name... Honestly, how did you manage to land yourself in the hospital?”
nodes.slv2_018: Settling back onto the pillow, Yuko tipped her chin up and looked her old classmate over from head to toe—the crisp white coat, the neat physician's badge on her chest, the stethoscope draped around her neck, and the understated slim dark-navy headband keeping her long hair impeccably in place.
nodes.slv2_019: “Back in school I already knew you were amazing at everything, sure, yet seeing THE Shiori standing beside my bed in a white coat still feels like walking onto a medical drama set... Meanwhile, here I am reuniting with an old classmate in this plain hospital gown without even curling my bangs—talk about humiliating!”
nodes.slv2_020: Shiori couldn't help letting out a soft laugh; she pulled over the round bedside stool, sat down, and opened the admission folder in her hands.
nodes.slv2_021: “Nobody on the ward is grading your bangs. Though seeing you still have the energy to worry about how your gown looks does put my mind a little more at ease—we can catch up properly once you're discharged, so for now, give your attending doctor an honest rundown of your symptoms.”
nodes.slv2_022: Meeting Shiori's gentle yet unmistakably no-nonsense gaze, Yuko tucked her neck in slightly and dutifully pulled the quilt up to her waist.
nodes.slv2_023: “Um... well, over the past couple of months, whenever I go out with friends to a trendy spot and eat something a bit greasy, or pull an all-nighter rushing a proposal, this spot on the right side of my belly starts cramping up in waves.”
nodes.slv2_024: Shiori listened attentively while making crisp notes beside the medical history column with her fountain pen.
nodes.slv2_025: “Did you have it checked at a hospital the first two times it flared up?”
nodes.slv2_026: “I stopped by the little clinic downstairs from my office once. The doctor said it was just ordinary gastrointestinal spasms from eating too rich a mix of food and gave me some antispasmodic and digestive tablets—usually sleeping it off took care of it. Then last night I went out with coworkers to that newly opened yakiniku place, and past two in the morning the cramping started up again, plus waves of nausea when I woke up, so I couldn't tough it out anymore and took a cab straight here to Hoshimi Hospital.”
nodes.slv2_027: Shiori nodded and turned a page to review the initial lab and imaging screening results from earlier that morning.
nodes.slv2_028: “Now that you've finished your morning IV fluids and rested your stomach for a few hours, does it still hurt when nothing is pressing on it?”
nodes.slv2_029: “Way better than when I walked in this morning! As long as I lie still and don't press down hard on it, there's basically just a dull, bloated feeling left.”
nodes.slv2_030: Having said that, Yuko cast a hopeful glance at the folder in Shiori's hands, peeked out toward a treatment cart rolling down the corridor, and unconsciously lowered her voice.
nodes.slv2_031: “Um... Shiori, since it barely hurts anymore after the drip, it's probably just acute gastroenteritis from overdoing the barbecue last night, right? I've hated the smell of disinfectant ever since I was a kid... Once today's bag finishes, can't I just get some stomach medicine and head home?”
nodes.slv2_032: Shiori closed the lab sheet and raised her eyes to her old classmate—whose eagerness to slip away was written all over her face—speaking in an even, lucid tone.
nodes.slv2_033: “In this morning's bloodwork, your white cell count and inflammatory markers are only mildly elevated, your hepatobiliary and pancreatic enzymes are all normal, and your temperature has come back down to 36.8°C. Those really are good signs.”
nodes.slv2_034: Yuko's eyes had barely brightened halfway when Shiori turned gently to the bedside ultrasound report.
nodes.slv2_035: “However, during the initial ultrasound earlier, bowel gas obscured a small deep area in the right lower quadrant. Since this has flared up three times in the exact same spot over two months, to be safe we can't simply brush it off as an upset stomach and send you home with two boxes of gastric tablets.”
nodes.slv2_036: Yuko swallowed hard, her fingers instinctively tightening around the edge of her bedsheet.
nodes.slv2_037: “Th-then what else do we have to do? Don't scare me, Shiori—in my whole life I've never even seen which way the doors to an operating room swing...”
nodes.slv2_038: “That's why I just phoned the surgery department and asked a very dependable surgeon here at the hospital to come by this afternoon for a joint consultation—so we can evaluate your abdominal signs from a surgical standpoint right as the acute symptoms have settled.”
nodes.slv2_040: The corner of the quilt crumpled into a ball in Yuko's grip as half the color drained straight from her face.
nodes.slv2_041: “Hold on a second, Shiori! You smiled so sweetly when you called me ‘Yuko-chan’ two minutes ago, and now you're calling in someone who wields a scalpel?! Calling a surgeon to examine my stomach means you're getting ready to wheel me in and cut me open, doesn't it?!”
nodes.slv2_042: Watching her jump to conclusions, Shiori let out a soft, helpless sigh and reached out to pat the back of her hand where it clenched the quilt.
nodes.slv2_043: “Don't scare yourself. Asking a surgical colleague to consult is so we can rule out anything requiring urgent intervention first and narrow down the next diagnostic steps—it certainly doesn't mean immediate surgery. Take a deep breath and relax a little; judging by the time, Dr. Sakaguchi should be right outside.”
nodes.slv2_044: Two measured knocks sounded outside the ward door.
nodes.slv2_045: Shiori rose from her stool and stepped toward the entrance.
nodes.slv2_046: “Come in. Thank you for coming all the way up to the third floor, Dr. Sakaguchi.”
nodes.slv2_047: Ryuji Sakaguchi stepped into the ward carrying a surgical consultation clipboard and answered with a warm nod.
nodes.slv2_048: “Not at all—afternoon clinic had just wrapped up anyway.”
nodes.slv2_049: On the bed, Yuko—who had pulled the quilt all the way up under her chin with her eyes squeezed shut to brace herself—cracked one eye open. Seeing that the young male surgeon walking in wasn't wearing an intimidating mask and wasn't the stern, scowling old professor she had pictured, she blinked in surprise.
nodes.slv2_050: While Ryuji lowered his gaze to look over the admission summary Shiori handed him, Yuko sneaked two fingers out to tug lightly at Shiori's white-coat cuff and muttered under her breath.
nodes.slv2_051: “Hey, Shiori... THIS is the surgical colleague you meant? Here I thought a surgical consult meant some grumpy old grandpa—I had no idea the surgeons at your hospital were this handsome...”
nodes.slv2_052: A scarcely perceptible pause flickered at the base of Shiori's ear; she smoothly eased her cuff back and murmured a quiet reminder.
nodes.slv2_053: “Yuko-chan, the ward is very quiet. Dr. Sakaguchi can hear you.”
nodes.slv2_054: Ryuji looked up from the chart with a faint lift at the corner of his mouth and gave the young woman on the bed an unassuming nod.
nodes.slv2_055: “Hello, Ms. Asahina. I'm Ryuji Sakaguchi from Surgery. Dr. Fujisaki mentioned outside just now that the two of you were classmates back in high school?”
nodes.slv2_056: Warmth rushed into Yuko's cheeks; she straightened her back in a hurry and waved her hands with a sheepish laugh.
nodes.slv2_057: “Ah, y-yes! Hello, Dr. Sakaguchi! Sorry to drag you up here in the middle of the afternoon—honestly my stomach barely even hurts anymore, I feel like I could hop out of bed and walk around any second!”
nodes.slv2_058: Shiori moved to the left side of the bed, slipping seamlessly back into the crisp, lucid bearing of an internal medicine attending as she opened the key chart entries for Ryuji.
nodes.slv2_059: “Let me go over what Internal Medicine has gathered so far with Dr. Sakaguchi. This is the patient's third episode of paroxysmal cramping pain in the right mid-to-lower abdomen within two months; the previous two followed greasy meals or late nights and resolved spontaneously within several hours, without vomiting, melena, or urinary symptoms.”
nodes.slv2_060: “On admission this morning her temperature was 37.2°C, WBC 10.6, with mildly elevated inflammatory markers and normal hepatobiliary-pancreatic enzymes and urinalysis. Spontaneous pain subsided markedly after four hours of fasting and IV hydration; anticipating a surgical evaluation, we withheld strong analgesics this morning, though bowel gas partially obscured local right-sided echoes on initial bedside ultrasound.”
nodes.slv2_061: Ryuji scanned the lab slip and ultrasound notes carefully and nodded in agreement.
nodes.slv2_062: “Establishing a baseline abdominal palpation exam right after acute symptoms ease—without analgesics masking physical signs—is spot-on timing, Dr. Fujisaki. Waiting until markers shift again or medication blunts the response makes it much harder to compare how the abdomen feels under the hand.”
nodes.slv2_063: Meeting his eyes, Shiori gave a calm, assured nod.
nodes.slv2_064: “Yes, that was my thinking as well.”
nodes.slv2_065: Ryuji set his clipboard on the small table at the foot of the bed, pumped sanitizer from the bedside dispenser, rubbed his hands thoroughly until the chill faded from his fingertips, and stepped up to the right side of the bed.
nodes.slv2_066: “Ms. Asahina, I'm going to palpate your abdomen next to check for any abnormal superficial or deep tenderness. Please flatten the pillow behind you and lie on your back, bend both knees slightly, and push the hem of your gown top up to expose your abdomen.”
nodes.slv2_067: At the prospect of actually having her stomach pressed, Yuko's nerves—relaxed for scarcely half a minute—snapped right back tight.
nodes.slv2_068: Reluctantly lying flat and bending both knees, she pinched the loose hem of her hospital gown and drew it up below her chest, revealing a smooth, fair stretch of lower abdomen. Between the cool ward air brushing her skin, her self-consciousness with a young male surgeon standing beside the bed, and her instinctive dread of scalpels, she sucked in a deep breath and held it—tensing her belly stiff as a board.
nodes.slv2_069: “U-um, Dr. Sakaguchi, please press really gently in a second, okay?! Let me state for the record right now—I'm super ticklish AND super sensitive to pain, so if you press down and I accidentally let out a little ‘eep,’ that's 100% a reflex! You two aren't allowed to use one squeak as grounds to wheel me straight into surgery!”
nodes.slv2_070: Standing on the opposite side of the bed holding the edge of the quilt neat, Shiori looked equal parts amused and exasperated as she guided her in a gentle voice.
nodes.slv2_071: “Yuko-chan, if you hold your breath and brace your stomach like a wooden plank, Dr. Sakaguchi won't be able to feel what's actually going on inside and will have to examine you all over again. Come on, rest your shoulders back on the mattress and breathe out slowly through your mouth with me—”
nodes.slv2_072: Unrushed, Ryuji waited patiently until Yuko let out a long breath in time with Shiori's cue and her taut rectus muscles naturally softened before resting his warm palm flat against her painless left lower quadrant.
nodes.slv2_074: “...Oh? Your hand's warm—and it doesn't hurt at all over here.”
nodes.slv2_075: Moving with steady, methodical poise, Ryuji glided the pads of his joined fingers from superficial to deep across the left flank and epigastrium toward the periumbilical region and right mid-to-lower abdomen, gauging abdominal wall tone and deep resistance while asking calmly.
nodes.slv2_076: “When I press over this area on the right, is it a sharp needle-like sting, or a dull, heavy ache?”
nodes.slv2_077: Yuko bit lightly at her lower lip and focused on the sensation for two seconds.
nodes.slv2_078: “Mm... when you press deeper there's a slight dull, full ache, though nothing like that twisting pain from this morning.”
nodes.slv2_079: Ryuji held steady over the area of mild right-sided tenderness for a moment, then lifted his fingers cleanly.
nodes.slv2_080: “Right at the instant I let go like that, did a sharper cramp suddenly shoot through?”
nodes.slv2_081: “Nope—as soon as you lifted your hand it felt better.”
nodes.slv2_082: Ryuji nodded, slipped his stethoscope from around his neck to listen briefly for ten-odd seconds to bowel sounds on both sides of her abdomen, then put the stethoscope away, drew the hem of her hospital gown neatly back into place for her, and looked across the bed to Shiori.
nodes.slv2_083: “The abdomen is soft throughout without guarding or rebound tenderness, no distinct abnormal mass is palpable deep down, and bowel sounds are regular in rhythm—only mild localized tenderness remains on deep palpation in the right mid-to-lower quadrant. From a surgical standpoint, there are no signs of peritonitis, perforation, or acute obstruction, so there is no reason for immediate surgery right now.”
nodes.slv2_084: Listening closely to his physical findings, Shiori flipped open her orders folder and picked up the next step seamlessly.
nodes.slv2_085: “Having emergency operative risk ruled out first makes conservative observation much more reassuring. Still, since deep palpation does elicit a localized response—and this has recurred three times in two months—we should take advantage of this admission to pin down the underlying cause thoroughly.”
nodes.slv2_086: “Agreed. Operating rashly before the root cause is clear wouldn't do her any good. I suggest continuing IV hydration and observation for a day or two under your internal medicine plan, Dr. Fujisaki—keep her fasting tonight so the bowel can rest and clear the gas, continue withholding strong analgesics, and once the gas disperses tomorrow, follow up with targeted imaging of the right mid-to-lower abdomen. Whenever new results come back, I can come look at them together anytime.”
nodes.slv2_087: “All right, then let's lock in tomorrow morning's follow-up imaging slot and tonight's vital-sign monitoring along those lines.”
nodes.slv2_088: Having craned her ears to catch every word while watching both doctors' faces, Yuko lit up at once, propping her upper body up against the mattress with both hands to double-check eagerly.
nodes.slv2_089: “So... I don't have to get cut open today?”
nodes.slv2_090: Looking at her tense expression, Ryuji answered in a warm yet precise voice.
nodes.slv2_091: “Not at present. First we'll clarify the diagnosis further.”
nodes.slv2_092: Yuko let out one huge breath, every ounce of tension draining out of her at once as she sank limply back into her soft pillow and patted her chest.
nodes.slv2_093: “Thank goodness... Watching the two of you trading looks over your clipboards just now, I seriously thought I was getting wheeled into the OR before the afternoon was out...”
nodes.slv2_094: Standing beside the bed, Shiori capped her fountain pen with a click, watching her old classmate get carried away within a single second as a gentle—yet utterly unyielding—smile curved her lips.
nodes.slv2_095: “There are still several follow-up exams ahead, however.”
nodes.slv2_096: “...I knew I wasn't getting off that easily.”
nodes.slv2_097: Shiori leaned down to tuck the corner of the quilt Yuko had mussed back into place, then glanced up to check the drip rate on the IV stand.
nodes.slv2_098: “And so tomorrow morning's follow-up scan comes out clear, you'll still be fasting on IV fluids under observation tonight—no sneaking down to the first-floor lobby vending machines for sweet drinks, understand?”
nodes.slv2_099: Pulling the quilt mournfully up to her chin, Yuko rolled her eyes toward Ryuji beside the bed and broke into a grin that was half complaint, half teasing.
nodes.slv2_100: “Aww, even sweet drinks got banned in advance... Dr. Sakaguchi, our Shiori was famous for being the model honor student back in school—when you work with her around the hospital, is she so strict that none of you dare crack a joke either?”
nodes.slv2_101: Ryuji glanced toward Shiori standing somewhat helplessly beside the bed, the corner of his mouth curving up.
nodes.slv2_102: “She really is thorough when it comes to work. Though seeing Dr. Fujisaki sighing while coaxing a patient to lie still like this afternoon definitely isn't an everyday sight around the hospital.”
nodes.slv2_104: “Hehe, naturally! After knowing her all these years, I'm probably the only one bold enough to act a little spoiled in front of the great Dr. Fujisaki!”
nodes.slv2_105: Shiori cast a light sidelong glance at the two of them, the faintest trace of bashful amusement tinting her fair ears.
nodes.slv2_106: “...Why are you joining in with Yuko-chan too, Dr. Sakaguchi? Keep fussing instead of resting flat, and I'll ask the nurses to make your bed the very first stop for tomorrow morning's fasting blood draw.”
nodes.slv2_107: Glancing at the neatly structured consultation sheet in his hand, Ryuji gave an easy, unhurried smile.
nodes.slv2_108: “I wouldn't call her strict—patients and colleagues alike trust her deeply around here. Even before calling me up just now, she already had the triggers for all three of your episodes and the exact differentials to rule out organized crystal-clear.”
nodes.slv2_109: Yuko nodded vigorously, patting her quilt with unmistakable pride.
nodes.slv2_110: “I knew it! Even picking a hospital with my eyes closed, landing in Shiori's hands is hands-down the safest bet!”
nodes.slv2_111: Shiori's fingers paused lightly over her chart pages as a soft smile curved her lips.
nodes.slv2_112: “Enough flattering me—cooperating properly with tonight's fasting and observation is what actually matters.”
nodes.slv2_113: Settling obediently back onto her pillow, Yuko flashed the two of them an ‘aye-aye’ salute.
nodes.slv2_114: “Roger that, Attending Physician Fujisaki! And thank you for today too, Dr. Sakaguchi!”
nodes.slv2_115: “Get plenty of rest. If your abdominal pain worsens this evening or overnight, or if you feel chills or a fever coming on, press your call bell for the staff right away.”
nodes.slv2_116: Checking the bedside monitoring log one last time, Shiori walked out of the ward side by side with Ryuji and gently pulled the door shut.
nodes.slv2_117: At 5:25 in the evening, a soft tangerine glow tinted the sky beyond the windows; the daytime bustle of the outpatient lobby had long since dispersed, leaving the first-floor connecting corridor quiet and bright.
nodes.slv2_118: Having just signed off on the day's final consultation filing slip in the surgical office, Ryuji was heading toward the staff locker corridor when he spotted Shiori stepping out of the inpatient elevator ahead. Unburdened by chart folders, she glanced briefly at her phone screen before slipping it back into her white-coat pocket, both her step and the expression around her eyes noticeably lighter than at the end of a typical shift.
nodes.slv2_119: Ryuji slowed to a stop and greeted her.
nodes.slv2_120: “Dr. Fujisaki—just coming down from the third-floor ward?”
nodes.slv2_121: Looking up at the sound of his voice, Shiori broke into a relaxed, warm smile.
nodes.slv2_122: “Ah, Dr. Sakaguchi—are you all wrapped up too? I just stopped by Bed 21 to check on Yuko-chan one more time before clocking out.”
nodes.slv2_124: “Very stable. Her temperature has stayed at 36.7°C, her stomach hasn't cramped up again since finishing this afternoon's bag of fluids, and she was fast asleep under her quilt when I peeked in. I've already handed off tonight's observation points and tomorrow morning's fasting follow-up in person to both the on-call doctor and the night-shift nurses.”
nodes.slv2_125: Stopping in front of Ryuji, she offered him an earnest, gentle word of thanks.
nodes.slv2_126: “You really helped me out during this afternoon's consultation, Dr. Sakaguchi. Having you examine her so patiently and explain in person why surgery isn't needed right now settled her nerves all at once.”
nodes.slv2_127: “Just doing my part—your history-taking and initial workup had already laid the groundwork anyway. Though judging by the good mood you were in stepping out of the elevator just now, is there more to it than your old classmate stabilizing?”
nodes.slv2_128: Shiori blinked in slight surprise, unconsciously brushing the corner of her mouth with her fingertips before letting out a slightly sheepish laugh.
nodes.slv2_129: “...Was it showing that clearly? It's really just a small personal thing. About two months ago, I pre-ordered a hard-to-find remastered recording at a classical record shop near the hospital, and the shop just messaged me that it finally arrived this afternoon.”
nodes.slv2_130: Ryuji raised an eyebrow with genuine interest.
nodes.slv2_131: “A classical record shop? Right near our hospital? I walk the station route back and forth every day and somehow never noticed one.”
nodes.slv2_132: At the mention of a familiar haunt, a natural note of buoyancy entered Shiori's voice.
nodes.slv2_133: “Yes—it's tucked down that little elm-lined side street halfway toward the station. The storefront is modest and its wooden sign sits under the shade of the trees, so if you stay on the main avenue it really is easy to walk right past. Inside, though, the records are wonderfully curated; pushing open the door feels almost like stepping into another season—quiet and restful.”
nodes.slv2_134: Pausing there as she looked at Ryuji's unhurried demeanor, something seemed to occur to her; her clear eyes curved slightly as she asked with natural poise.
nodes.slv2_135: “You head toward the station on your way home too, don't you, Dr. Sakaguchi? If you don't have anything urgent this evening... would you like to swing by together on the way? It's barely a five-minute detour, so it won't hold you up long.”
nodes.slv2_136: “I don't have any plans tonight anyway. With a recommendation like that from Dr. Fujisaki, I'd be glad to tag along and see the place.”
nodes.slv2_137: Shiori's eyes brightened faintly, her smile growing all the warmer and clearer.
nodes.slv2_138: “Wonderful. Shall we each go change in the locker rooms and meet outside the first-floor main entrance in ten minutes?”
nodes.slv2_140: Ten minutes later, when Ryuji pushed open the glass doors of the hospital's main entrance in casual clothes, Shiori was already waiting beside the steps in the gathering dusk.
nodes.slv2_141: Out of the crisp white coat she wore during the day, a soft pale-beige knit top paired with a tailored light-camel trench coat lent her silhouette a slender grace; the evening breeze brushing past her cheek caught the warm sheen of a deep burgundy velvet headband nestled in her long hair. As she turned at the sound of the door, most of the taut poise of an ‘attending physician’ had already melted away.
nodes.slv2_142: “Have you been waiting long? We just turn down the corner up ahead.”
nodes.slv2_143: Walking side by side across the busy main-avenue crosswalk, the two of them turned onto a quiet side street lined with old elm trees.
nodes.slv2_144: Past a bakery fragrant with freshly pulled evening loaves and a secondhand bookshop, a spotless dark-walnut glass door came into view beneath a modest, vintage brass sign.
nodes.slv2_146: Ryuji pushed open the wooden door and stepped aside to let Shiori enter first as the brass bell overhead chimed with a clear, mellow ring.
nodes.slv2_147: The shop interior wasn't large; warm amber spotlights fell quietly across rows of natural wood shelves sorted by composer and genre, a subtle scent of paper sleeves and beeswax drifting in the air while a pair of vintage wooden-cabinet speakers in the corner murmured a limpid, unhurried dialogue of strings and piano.
nodes.slv2_148: Behind the counter, an older clerk with silver-streaked hair and thin-rimmed glasses was wiping down a vinyl sleeve; looking up at the chime of the bell and spotting the newcomer, his face broke immediately into a familiar, welcoming smile.
nodes.slv2_149: “Good evening, Ms. Fujisaki. Off work right on time today, eh?”
nodes.slv2_150: Standing beneath the warm amber light, Shiori's eyes curved naturally, her voice carrying an easy everyday warmth quite distinct from the hospital corridors.
nodes.slv2_151: “Good evening. Things wrapped up smoothly on the ward today, so I came straight over as soon as I saw your message.”
nodes.slv2_152: With a genial smile, the older clerk offered a polite nod to Ryuji beside her as well before setting down his cloth and turning toward the back storage room.
nodes.slv2_153: “That remastered box set you reserved was just unpacked this afternoon—I tucked it away in the back cabinet so nobody out here would bump the corners. Feel free to browse with your friend while I fetch it and wrap it up for you.”
nodes.slv2_155: Once the clerk lifted the fabric curtain into the back room, Shiori turned to Ryuji and led him with light steps toward a central wooden rack lined with CDs and vinyl sleeves.
nodes.slv2_156: “Here it is. The space may be small, yet whether it's out-of-print analog recordings remastered from decades ago or new releases from the past few years, you can always find thoughtfully chosen editions here.”
nodes.slv2_157: Looking over the tidy wooden racks and the neat handwritten recommendation cards tucked along their edges, Ryuji's gaze settled on a divider labeled ‘Chopin: Piano Concerto No. 1 in E minor’—under that single title alone, seven or eight records with completely different covers stood side by side in the wooden slot.
nodes.slv2_158: Sliding one sleeve out half an inch to glance at the track timings on the back, Ryuji voiced an honest layman's question.
nodes.slv2_159: “Come to think of it, as an outsider I've always wondered about something. With pop songs, a cover artist can change the arrangement or singing style—yet in classical music everyone plays from the exact same score without altering a single note. Does it really sound all that different from one performer to another?”
nodes.slv2_160: Far from showing a hint of condescension at the straightforward question, Shiori's eyes lit up all at once.
nodes.slv2_161: “When I first started listening to classical music, I asked the exact same question.”
nodes.slv2_162: Stepping half a pace closer, she reached out with slender fingers, deftly drew two recordings of the same concerto from the wooden slot, and cradled one in each palm, angling slightly toward Ryuji so he could see them.
nodes.slv2_163: “Look at these two—both really are the exact same Chopin First Piano Concerto. The one in my left hand is a new studio recording from a couple of years ago: this pianist's touch is remarkably crisp, every note as clear and bright as a freshly wiped windowpane on a sunny morning, with impeccable rhythmic poise. Putting it on before heading out in the morning wakes your whole mind right up.”
nodes.slv2_164: Ryuji glanced down at the cool-toned modern photographic cover on the left, then shifted his gaze to the record in her right hand bearing a yellowed black-and-white photograph of an old concert hall.
nodes.slv2_165: “And what about this older one in your right hand?”
nodes.slv2_166: Lowering her eyes to the vintage sleeve resting on her right palm, Shiori's ordinarily poised, reserved expression grew vividly absorbed without her realizing it, a soft luster warming the cadence of her voice.
nodes.slv2_167: “This one on the right is a live concert hall recording from many years ago—if you listen closely during the quiet passages, you can even catch the faint creak of the wooden pedal. Yet when the music reaches the gentlest slow section of the second movement, right before striking the very first note of the main theme, this pianist always holds their breath for half a second longer than the standard tempo on the page—”
nodes.slv2_168: As she spoke, her right index finger hovered lightly above the album cover before settling down, the warm amber spotlight reflected in her clear, shining pupils.
nodes.slv2_169: “Almost like someone standing by a window at night, about to say something to the person beside them, only to pause right as the words reach their lips. Not a single note has changed, and the orchestral strings underneath trace the exact same line—yet that extra half-beat of hesitant breath suddenly fills the piano with human warmth... So whenever I come off a night shift or feel worn out in the evening, this is still the one I love pulling off the shelf most.”
nodes.slv2_170: Standing beside the wooden rack, Ryuji listened quietly as her clear, gentle voice wove through the piano music drifting across the shop, his gaze resting naturally on her softly shining eyes and expressive fingertips.
nodes.slv2_171: Only when her last word settled softly into two seconds of quiet did Shiori look up—meeting Ryuji's attentive gaze head-on.
nodes.slv2_172: Her poised hand froze midair as it belatedly dawned on her that she had stepped half a pace closer to his side without noticing and rattled on at such length. A pale blush crept swiftly up the tips of her fair ears; hurrying to slip both records neatly back into their wooden slot, she pressed her lips together in slight embarrassment.
nodes.slv2_173: “...Ah—I'm sorry, Dr. Sakaguchi. The moment I saw a piece I know well, I got carried away talking non-stop... Did all of that sound overly trivial?”
nodes.slv2_174: Ryuji shook his head, his tone candid and unforced.
nodes.slv2_175: “Not trivial at all. I don't know music theory, yet hearing you describe ‘that extra half-second of held breath’ painted the picture right away—now even I'm curious to hear how the two compare side by side.”
nodes.slv2_176: Shiori blinked for half a beat as the slight self-consciousness in her eyes melted away at once, her brows curving with genuine delight.
nodes.slv2_177: “Really? Here I was worried my way of describing it was much too personal... Sparking even a little curiosity in you already feels like quite an accomplishment, Dr. Sakaguchi.”
nodes.slv2_179: “Much more interesting than going over lab sheets at the hospital. Around the wards we always see the composed, measured ‘Dr. Fujisaki’—getting to see you this absorbed talking about something you love is a refreshing change.”
nodes.slv2_180: Resting her fingertips lightly along the edge of the wooden shelf, her cheeks warmed faintly as her gaze softened with quiet candor.
nodes.slv2_181: “Everyone at the hospital is usually rushed off their feet, so there's rarely a chance to talk about things like this... Having you listen so attentively made me get a little carried away before I knew it, Dr. Sakaguchi.”
nodes.slv2_182: Just then, the fabric curtain to the back room parted, and the older clerk stepped out cradling a boxed record set carefully wrapped in a deep brown kraft paper bag.
nodes.slv2_183: “Sorry to keep you waiting, Ms. Fujisaki. Only three boxes of this imported remastered set were allocated to us—I checked the shrink-wrap and all four corners for you, and it's in mint condition.”
nodes.slv2_184: Stepping briskly up to the counter to settle the balance, Shiori received the kraft paper bag in both hands and held it against her chest with polite, unmistakable delight.
nodes.slv2_185: “Thank you so much for holding onto it for me all this time.”
nodes.slv2_186: “Don't mention it—when a regular reserves a set, of course we keep it safe and sound. Enjoy listening at home, and take care on your way, both of you!”
nodes.slv2_187: With her long-awaited box set tucked safely in hand, the two of them strolled slowly toward the front door past the glass display case of commemorative vinyl editions by the window.
nodes.slv2_188: Passing the glass pane lit by warm amber strip lighting, Shiori shifted the kraft paper bag into the crook of her left arm and freed her right hand to habitually tuck back a few long strands of hair that had slipped past her cheek while browsing the lower racks—her fingertips brushing up naturally to straighten the deep burgundy velvet headband atop her head.
nodes.slv2_189: The glass panel reflected the muted crimson sheen of the velvet and its delicate side clasp in crisp detail. Slowing slightly, Ryuji let his gaze rest naturally on her hair.
nodes.slv2_190: “You really seem to like headbands, Dr. Fujisaki.”
nodes.slv2_191: Her fingers stilled lightly beside a lock of hair as she turned her head toward Ryuji beside her.
nodes.slv2_193: “In the lounge last time too—during this afternoon's ward consult you were wearing a slim dark-navy one, and when you changed into casual clothes after work just now, you swapped headbands to match.”
nodes.slv2_194: Hearing that he had even noticed the difference between her daytime and off-duty styles, a flicker of mild surprise crossed Shiori's eyes before she touched the edge of the velvet band with a trace of shyness and slowed her pace.
nodes.slv2_195: “...You even noticed that I changed into another one, Dr. Sakaguchi? Yes—I've loved them ever since my school days. Whenever I pass an accessory shop and spot a fabric or color that catches my eye, I end up bringing it home, and before I knew it I'd filled a whole drawer at home.”
nodes.slv2_196: There, her voice trailed into a brief pause.
nodes.slv2_197: Quiet corner light fell across her gentle profile. Shifting her gaze slightly toward her own soft reflection in the glass display case, a faint, hesitant smile touched her lips.
nodes.slv2_198: “Though... sometimes when I stand in front of the mirror getting ready in the morning, I do wonder a little. I've already been working for several years now, yet in private I'm still fond of dressing like this... Looking at it nowadays, does it come across as a little old-fashioned?”
nodes.slv2_199: Looking at her lowered eyelashes and the understated note of deep burgundy nestled in her hair, Ryuji answered in a steady, matter-of-fact voice.
nodes.slv2_200: “I think it suits you very well. Not old-fashioned at all—it already feels unmistakably like your own style, Dr. Fujisaki.”
nodes.slv2_202: Raising her eyes to Ryuji, her ordinarily calm, composed pupils held a rare, unguarded trace of earnestness seeking confirmation.
nodes.slv2_204: Meeting her gaze, Ryuji gave an assured nod.
nodes.slv2_205: “Yes. And the one you changed into today goes really well with the color of your trench coat, too.”
nodes.slv2_206: Lingering piano notes drifted gently through the quiet air of the shop.
nodes.slv2_207: Taking in his wholly unfeigned expression for a second, Shiori slowly lowered her fingers from the edge of her headband back onto the kraft paper bag at her chest. A faint, warm flush rose across her fair cheeks; shifting her gaze half an inch aside, her lips curved into a genuinely unguarded, gentle smile.
nodes.slv2_208: “I'm glad... Hearing you say that puts my mind a little at ease, Dr. Sakaguchi.”
nodes.slv2_209: By the time they pushed open the walnut glass door and stepped back outside, night had fallen completely, rows of warm streetlamps glowing along both sides of the elm-lined side street.
nodes.slv2_210: A cool evening breeze brushed away the last traces of daytime fatigue. Walking unhurriedly side by side along the stone-paved sidewalk for a few minutes, the two of them reached the fork at the station plaza—to the left shone the illuminated sign of the subway entrance, while to the right stood the bus stop heading toward the residential district.
nodes.slv2_211: Pausing beneath a streetlamp, Shiori cradled the kraft paper bag holding her remastered records lightly in both hands and turned to face Ryuji.
nodes.slv2_212: Thinking back over everything inside the shop just now, she couldn't help lowering her eyes with a soft laugh tinged with rare bashfulness.
nodes.slv2_213: “I'm sorry about today, Dr. Sakaguchi. At first I only meant to thank you for helping with Yuko-chan's consultation this afternoon when I invited you along on a whim... yet once we stepped inside, I ended up doing almost all the talking from start to finish—even bringing up something as small as collecting headbands.”
nodes.slv2_214: Hands tucked loosely into the pockets of his casual jacket, Ryuji answered with easy composure.
nodes.slv2_215: “Nothing to apologize for. When we run into each other at the hospital, nine sentences out of ten revolve around test orders and shift rosters; taking a detour after work into a shop I'd never normally visit and hearing about life outside the wards was far more relaxing than heading straight for the train.”
nodes.slv2_216: At his words, Shiori lifted her gaze gently, the warm glow of the station plaza reflected in her clear, soft eyes.
nodes.slv2_217: Glancing down at the neatly folded top of the kraft paper bag in her arms, she brushed its crease lightly with her fingertips, paused half a beat, and spoke in a quiet voice tinged with understated hope.
nodes.slv2_218: “Then... once I unwrap this set tonight and listen through it, if there are pieces inside that aren't too abstruse—ones suited to unwinding quietly after work—when the chance comes up again someday, may I share other music I like with you, Dr. Sakaguchi?”
nodes.slv2_220: “Of course. Just remember to pick something approachable for me first—if the version comparisons get too intricate, I'm afraid these layman's ears of mine won't catch them right away.”
nodes.slv2_221: A soft laugh escaped Shiori as her eyes curved gently into crescents.
nodes.slv2_222: “Don't worry—I'll be sure to pick the most soothing, lovely track first.”
nodes.slv2_223: Ryuji nodded, his gaze resting on the kraft paper bag in her arms.
nodes.slv2_224: “Sure. I'm pretty curious myself what a recording that kept Dr. Fujisaki waiting two whole months feels like once you put it on.”
nodes.slv2_225: Hugging the paper bag a touch closer, a bright, warm smile rippled across Shiori's lips.
nodes.slv2_226: “Yes—once I've listened through it properly, I'll tell you my impressions next time we run into each other in the lounge.”
nodes.slv2_227: The evening breeze rustled gently through the treetops across the station plaza as the distant murmur of an arriving train drifted over.
nodes.slv2_228: Straightening her posture, Shiori offered Ryuji a poised, gentle nod.
nodes.slv2_229: “Thank you so much for everything today, Dr. Sakaguchi—both on the ward and for keeping me company on this detour after work. Well then... get home safely, and see you at the hospital tomorrow.”
nodes.slv2_230: “You too—get home safely, and see you tomorrow, Dr. Fujisaki.”
nodes.slv2_231: Cradling the record bag against her chest, Shiori turned and walked with light, unhurried steps toward the right-hand bus stop beneath the warm glow of the streetlamps.
